method: Intersect hybrid p0.50 with union of Kraken provider line-boundary polygons after isotropic dilation.

whole_component_policy.rule: Keep each complete raw-hybrid connected component when its fraction inside the dilated line corridor meets the threshold.

decision_policy: Visual acting-safe characterization only; no radius may be promoted without complete-mask evaluation and correction-effort measurement.

post_run_acting_safe_visual_review.pixel_clipping: All tested line-polygon intersections remove both glass rings, but they visibly trim real strokes where Kraken line boundaries are imperfect. Pixel clipping is rejected as a final ink operation.
post_run_acting_safe_visual_review.whole_component_overlap_0.10: Too permissive on this page. It restores the bottom glass ring and vertical page edge.
post_run_acting_safe_visual_review.whole_component_overlap_0.25: Promising page-bound candidate. It preserves admitted components intact, selects 204368 pixels (82.21% of raw hybrid), and visually removes both glass rings and the vertical page edge.
post_run_acting_safe_visual_review.whole_component_overlap_0.50: Too strict on this page. Relative to 0.25 it removes exactly one additional 2923-pixel component near the top writing line.
post_run_acting_safe_visual_review.limitation: Kraken detected only 14 lines. Unmodelled salutation, signature, marginalia, page number, or rotated writing must remain visible in residual/alternate-orientation queues rather than being deleted.
post_run_acting_safe_visual_review.next_test: Freeze the 30px/0.25 whole-component candidate on independent pages with existing line geometry, then evaluate complete human masks only after freeze.
